title: Slice of pizza
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="crust" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e8a33d"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c47a22"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cheese" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffd94a"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#f5b800"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <g transform="translate(50,52) rotate(-15) translate(-50,-52)">
    <!-- crust -->
    <path d="M18 26 L50 20 L82 26 Q86 34 82 42 L50 92 L18 42 Q14 34 18 26 Z" fill="url(#crust)" stroke="#f2c06a" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- cheese top -->
    <path d="M22 34 L50 28 L78 34 L50 84 Z" fill="url(#cheese)" stroke="#ffea8a" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- sauce hints -->
    <path d="M27 40 L50 35 L73 40 L50 77 Z" fill="#ff8a3d" opacity="0.55"/>
    <!-- pepperoni -->
    <circle cx="40" cy="44" r="6.5" fill="#d9412b" stroke="#ff7a5c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="45" r="6.5" fill="#d9412b" stroke="#ff7a5c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="6.5" fill="#d9412b" stroke="#ff7a5c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="57" r="3.5" fill="#c9412b" stroke="#ff7a5c" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="58" r="3.5" fill="#c9412b" stroke="#ff7a5c" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <!-- basil -->
    <path d="M46 50 Q50 46 55 50 Q50 54 46 50 Z" fill="#4fc95a" stroke="#9dff9d" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <path d="M36 65 Q40 61 45 65 Q40 69 36 65 Z" fill="#4fc95a" stroke="#9dff9d" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <!-- crust highlight -->
    <path d="M20 30 Q50 24 80 30" fill="none" stroke="#ffe0a0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- cheesy drip -->
    <path d="M32 78 Q34 86 38 80" fill="#ffd94a" stroke="#ffea8a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M62 76 Q64 84 68 78" fill="#ffd94a" stroke="#ffea8a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
</svg>
